Title: Door controller firmware updated without regression test
Lesson: A late firmware update of the door controller was not regression-tested and caused door obstruction faults during the type test. Freeze door firmware before type testing and run the full door regression suite for every change, including small fixes.

Title: Door obstruction detection too sensitive in winter
Lesson: Ice on door seals triggered false obstruction alarms in winter. Include door tests in climatic chamber at -25 C and define seal heating in the requirements from the start.

Title: Door software change again not regression tested
Lesson: A hotfix to the door control software was deployed on site without the regression suite and caused a door fault in passenger trial runs. Enforce the release gate: no software to site without signed regression report.

Title: Platform screen door interface defined too late
Lesson: The interface to the platform screen doors was frozen only after vehicle design review, causing rework of door timing. Agree the PSD interface control document before the preliminary design review.

Title: Bogie frame weld cracks found during fatigue test
Lesson: Cracks at a bogie frame weld appeared in the fatigue test due to steep-gradient load cases not in the specification. Include route-specific load cases (gradients, curves) in the bogie fatigue analysis early.

Title: Wheel wear higher than predicted on tight curves
Lesson: Wheel flange wear was twice the prediction on tight curves. Run wheel-rail interaction simulation with the real track geometry and agree a lubrication strategy with the operator.

Title: HVAC capacity insufficient for crowded peak hours
Lesson: HVAC was sized for nominal load, not crush load with summer peaks. Size HVAC for crush load at maximum ambient temperature and validate with the customer's passenger load profile.

Title: HVAC condensate leaking into passenger area
Lesson: Condensate drain hoses were routed without slope and leaked into the ceiling. Add drain routing to the manufacturing check list and perform a water test before roof closure.

Title: Brake test results not accepted by assessor
Lesson: The independent assessor rejected brake test results because the test plan was not agreed in advance. Agree test plans with the assessor before testing and keep them under configuration control.

Title: Multi-system pantograph switching caused arcing
Lesson: Arcing occurred at system separation sections because the pantograph lowering sequence was too slow. Validate system change sequences on a test track with all voltage systems before network tests.

Title: ETCS onboard integration delayed by supplier
Projects: Nordhaven Regional EMU; Kestrel Commuter Upgrade
Lesson: The ETCS onboard supplier delivered the interface specification months late. With multiple suppliers, define interface milestones in the supplier contract with penalties and hold monthly integration meetings.

Title: ATO over ETCS test slots not available
Lesson: Night test slots on the network for ATO tests were booked too late. Book network test slots with the infrastructure manager at contract signature.

Title: TCMS software baselines mixed between trains
Lesson: Different trains ran different TCMS software versions, making fault analysis impossible. Use a configuration management tool that records software versions per train and block mixed baselines.

Title: TCMS migration underestimated in refurbishment
Lesson: The effort to migrate legacy signals to the new TCMS was underestimated because old wiring documentation was incomplete. Do a site survey of a vehicle before the tender price is fixed.

Title: Coupler mismatch with existing fleet
Lesson: The coupler height did not match the customer's existing wagons. Collect the existing fleet interface data (coupler type, height) during tender clarification.

Title: Traction converter overheating in tunnel sections
Projects: Valoria Metro Line 4; Valoria Airport Shuttle
Lesson: Converters overheated in long tunnels with low airflow. Include tunnel ambient conditions in the thermal design and test with restricted airflow.

Title: Interior panel supplier quality escapes
Lesson: Interior panels arrived with colour deviations that were found only at final assembly. Introduce first-article inspection at the supplier and a colour reference sample approved by the customer.

Title: Passenger information screens failed EMC test
Lesson: New passenger information screens failed EMC tests because off-the-shelf units were not rail-qualified. Specify EN 50121 compliance for all off-the-shelf electronics in purchase orders.

Title: Winter package missing for sand and snow
Lesson: Snow ploughs and heated sand pipes were not in the scope although the route crosses mountains. Check the climatic route profile during the tender and include the winter package as an option.

Title: Driverless obstacle detection false positives
Lesson: Obstacle detection on driverless trains stopped trains for leaves and paper. Collect real track data early and tune the detection thresholds with the safety team before passenger service.

Title: Spare parts list delivered late to operator
Lesson: The operator received the recommended spare parts list after fleet introduction, causing long downtime. Deliver the spare parts list with the first train and align it with the maintenance plan.

Title: Sleeper coach berth fire test repeated
Lesson: The berth mattress failed the fire test because material certificates were for a different thickness. Require fire certificates for the exact material configuration before ordering samples.

Title: Customer change requests not tracked
Lesson: Verbal change requests from the customer were implemented without contract amendments. Log every change request in the change register and agree cost and time impact before implementation.

Title: Brake pad wear on steep gradients
Lesson: Brake pads wore out three times faster on the steep sections. Simulate the braking energy for the real gradient profile and prefer electric braking with energy recovery.

Title: Door software regression suite incomplete
Lesson: The door regression suite did not cover the platform screen door synchronisation cases. Add PSD synchronisation scenarios to the door regression suite and review it for each new project.

Title: Pantograph carbon strip supplier change
Lesson: Draft: supplier change for carbon strips caused higher wear. Analysis still ongoing.

Title: Cable routing clash in underframe
Training for operator maintenance staff too late
Lesson: Maintenance staff were trained after trains entered service. Plan operator training to finish before the first train handover and use the real vehicle for practical sessions.

Title: Multi-voltage homologation in each country took longer
Lesson: Each country required its own tests although the locomotive was certified elsewhere. Plan cross-acceptance per country early and budget for national tests.

Title: Ignore: duplicate test entry
Lesson: Duplicate of 1001 entered by mistake.

Title: Door supplier changed seal material without notice
Lesson: The door supplier switched the seal compound to a cheaper material without a change notification, which caused leaks in the rain test. Require formal change notifications from suppliers in the purchase contract and repeat the rain test after any material change.

Title: HVAC supplier spare parts lead time too long
Lesson: HVAC compressors had a 20-week lead time, so trains stood still during warranty repairs. Agree a consignment stock of critical HVAC spares with the supplier before fleet introduction.
